text: dsh-price-tip 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的 DeepSeek API 价格时段提示插件。它把状态徽标注册到侧栏底部，按北京时间显示当前是高峰还是空闲、距切换的倒计时，并在展开面板中展示规则、模型价目表和官方价格说明链接。规则包含工作日时段、周末与 2026 年节假日处理及空闲价折扣；可选账户面板通过 DSH 的账户 Remote 显示登录账户余额并支持刷新和充值入口。适合希望掌握 DeepSeek API 当前计价时段和账户余额的 DSH Web 用户；无需额外密钥或插件配置，余额区块取决于配置档是否提供账户服务。

dsh-price-tip adds a DeepSeek pricing badge to the DSH Web sidebar. It shows Beijing-time peak or off-peak status and a countdown; its panel lists rules and prices. An optional section shows the signed-in balance using DSH account services, with refresh and top-up links. No extra API key is needed.
想在 DSH 侧栏随时看 DeepSeek API 现在是高峰价还是空闲价。
距离 DeepSeek 下一次价格时段切换还有多久？
让 DSH 展示 DeepSeek 模型在当前时段的输入和输出价格。
周末或节假日调用模型是不是空闲价，能不能直接看提醒？
Show me whether DeepSeek API is in peak or off-peak hours in the DSH sidebar.
Can I see the current model prices and my signed-in balance in one DSH panel?
dsh-price-tip 的功能「峰谷时段徽标」：在 DSH Web 侧栏底部显示当前 DeepSeek API 处于高峰还是空闲时段，并展示切换倒计时。规则按北京时间工作日窗口计算，周末和已列出的节假日全天为空闲。
dsh-price-tip 的功能「模型价格表」：打开侧栏徽标后可查看 DeepSeek 模型在当前时段的缓存命中、缓存未命中和输出单价；空闲时段同时对照高峰标准价。
dsh-price-tip 的功能「账户余额」：打开详情面板时通过 DSH 可选账户服务读取已登录账户的钱包余额，显示充值与赠送余额、更新时间，并提供手动刷新和服务返回的充值链接。
dsh-price-tip 的功能「双语界面」：价格提示与详情面板提供中文和英文文案，并读取 DSH 当前界面语言来格式化切换时间。
dsh-price-tip 使用内置 2026 年节假日日历，当前年份超出覆盖范围时会按工作日估算峰谷并在面板提示；后续年份的节假日规则可能需要维护。
能不能在 DSH 里同时看 DeepSeek 峰谷规则和每百万 tokens 的价格？
I want a small DSH sidebar reminder for when DeepSeek API rates change.

dsh-price-tip README · dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek 价格时段提醒：*[English](README.en.md) · 中文*

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：在 Web 界面**侧栏底部**常驻一个价格时段标记，显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于
**空闲时段**还是**高峰时段**、距下次切换还有多久；点开是规则说明、当前生效的价目表，以及已登录
DeepSeek 账户的余额。

*侧栏底部实拍：绿色月牙 = 空闲时段，状态文案旁是绿色口号，右侧为距下次切换的倒计时。*

*点击展开：当前时段与折扣、剩余时间与切换时刻（本机时区、跟随界面语言）、口号、账户余额（充值/赠送余额、
更新时间、刷新与去充值）、价目表（加粗为当前价、划线为高峰价），以及底部的规则与来源。深色主题下的侧栏与面板见
[docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)。*
section: dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek 价格时段提醒

text:
dsh-price-tip README · 它提醒什么：| 时段 | 北京时间 | 价格 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 高峰 | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日） | 标准价 |
| 空闲 | 其余全部时间，含周末与法定节假日全天 | 高峰价的 50% |

> ⚠️ 2025 年那套「00:30–08:30 错峰优惠」已于 2025-09-05 取消，`deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-reasoner`
> 也已于 2026-07-24 下线——**都不是现行规则**。规则与价目表以
> [DeepSeek 官方价格页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) 为准（核对于 2026-10-10）。

dsh-price-tip README · 特性：- **随日历走**：周末与法定节假日整天空闲；内置 2026 年落在工作日的 19 个节假日，日历未覆盖的年份标注「按工作日估算」。
- **余额**：展开面板即读一次已登录 DeepSeek 账户的余额（充值余额、赠送余额，两位小数 + 千分位，与「设置 → 账户」同口径），
  附更新时间、手动刷新与「去充值」入口。走 DSH 账户自身的 Remote 命名空间，插件**不接触任何密钥**；
  未登录时只显示一行提示，没有账户控制器的配置档则整个区块隐藏。只在打开面板时读取，不做轮询。
- **情绪价值**：空闲时段喊你「站起来蹬」，高峰时段提醒你「心疼着蹬」——侧栏那一行直接就能看到，点开还有完整一句「便宜时段，尽管使劲用」/「贵时段，蹬一下心疼一下」。
- **中英双语**：文案走 Harness 的 locale 命名空间，切换界面语言即时生效。
- **零依赖、免构建**：`client.js` 已提交进仓库，装上即用；Host 半边不注册任何工具或会话状态。
- **可自改**：规则、节假日与价目表在 `src/policy.js`，余额格式化与状态机在 `src/balance.js`，改完重建即可，见 [docs/development.md](docs/development.md)。

dsh-price-tip README · 如何安装：插件零依赖、无生命周期脚本，且**已提交构建产物**，因此安装时不需要任何构建步骤。
下面三条路径都在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测过（验证记录见 [docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)）。

| 路径 | 操作 | 适用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **GitHub**（推荐） | **设置 → 插件** → 粘贴 `https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip` | 一般使用 |
| **tarball** | `pnpm pack` 后，在安装框粘贴 `.tgz` 的绝对路径 | 离线 / 内网 / 锁版本 |
| **本地目录** | `git clone` 后，在安装框粘贴该目录的绝对路径 | 要改代码 |

前两条拿到的只有运行时文件与文档（无 `src/`、`scripts/`、`test/`）；要改规则请用本地目录方式。
命令行等价写法（仅限非 `desktop` 配置档）：

dsh-price-tip README · 如何安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip
```

dsh-price-tip README · 安装须知：- **桌面版只能走界面**：`desktop` 配置档由 Electron 独占，命令行会拒绝
  （`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。
- **装完刷新页面**：客户端 bundle 由 HMR 追加进引导图，刷新可确保生效。
- **本地目录装的是软链**（`link:`）：改完 `node scripts/build-client.mjs` 刷新即可，不必重装。
- **版本耦合**：样式只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题 token，槽位是 `sidebar.footer.action`，并由 `dsh.client.inject`
  依赖 DSH 自带的 sidebar 与 locale 客户端包；余额通过**可选**的 `remote.account` 命名空间读取
  （没有账户控制器的配置档自动隐藏该区块）；DSH 改槽位名、locale API 或账户 Remote 时需跟着调整。

dsh-price-tip README · dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek pricing-period tip：*English · [中文](README.md) — this is the English edition of [README.md](README.md), which stays canonical.*

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that keeps a pricing-period badge in the **sidebar footer** of the Web UI.
It shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently in an **off-peak** or **peak** period, plus how long until the
next switch. Click it to open the rules, the price table currently in force, and the balance of the signed-in
DeepSeek account.

dsh-price-tip README · dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek pricing-period tip：*The sidebar footer in the running app: a green crescent = off-peak, a green slogan next to the status text,
and a countdown to the next switch on the right.*

dsh-price-tip README · dsh-price-tip — DeepSeek pricing-period tip：*Click to expand: the current period and its discount, time remaining and the switch instant (local time zone,
following the UI language), the slogan, the account balance (topped-up and granted balance, last-updated time,
refresh and top-up actions), the price table (bold = price in force, struck through = peak price), and the
rules and sources at the bottom. For the sidebar and panel in the dark theme, see
[docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md).*

dsh-price-tip README · What it reminds you of：| Period | Beijing time | Price |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Peak | Mon–Fri 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 (Chinese public holidays excluded) | Standard price |
| Off-peak | All other times, including all day on weekends and public holidays | 50% of the peak price |

dsh-price-tip README · What it reminds you of：> ⚠️ The 2025 "00:30–08:30 off-peak discount" scheme was withdrawn on 2025-09-05, and `deepseek-chat` /
> `deepseek-reasoner` were retired on 2026-07-24 — **neither is the rule in force**. The rules and the price
> table follow the
> [official DeepSeek pricing page](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing) (checked 2026-10-10).

dsh-price-tip README · Features：- **Follows the calendar**: weekends and public holidays are off-peak the whole day; the 19 holidays that fall
  on weekdays in 2026 are built in, and years the calendar does not cover are labelled "estimated from weekdays".
- **Balance**: opening the panel reads the signed-in DeepSeek account once (topped-up balance, granted balance,
  two decimals with thousands separators — the same figures as "Settings → Account"), with a last-updated time,
  a manual refresh, and a top-up entry point. It goes through DSH's own Remote namespace and the plugin
  **never touches any credential**; when signed out it shows a single line of text, and a profile without an
  account controller hides the whole section. It reads only when the panel opens — no polling.
- **Mood value**: off-peak tells you to "Stand up and pedal", peak reminds you to "Wince as you pedal" — the
  sidebar line already carries it, and opening the panel gives the full sentence, "cheap hours — go all out" /
  "peak rates — every push stings".
- **Bilingual**: the copy lives in the Harness locale namespace, so switching the UI language takes effect
  immediately.

dsh-price-tip README · How to install：The plugin has zero dependencies and no lifecycle scripts, and it **ships its build output**, so installing it
needs no build step. All three paths below were exercised on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (the verification record is in
[docs/verification.md](docs/verification.md)).

dsh-price-tip README · How to install：| Path | What to do | When to use it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **GitHub** (recommended) | **Settings → Plugins** → paste `https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip` | General use |
| **Tarball** | Run `pnpm pack`, then paste the absolute path of the `.tgz` into the install box | Offline / intranet / pinned version |
| **Local directory** | `git clone`, then paste the absolute path of that directory into the install box | You want to change the code |

dsh-price-tip README · How to install：The first two give you only the runtime files and the documents (no `src/`, `scripts/` or `test/`); use the
local directory if you want to change the rules. The command-line equivalent (non-`desktop` profiles only):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/hojas/dsh-price-tip
```

dsh-price-tip README · Installation notes：- **The desktop app only takes the UI path**: the `desktop` profile is owned exclusively by Electron and the
  command line refuses it (`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`).
- **Refresh the page after installing**: the client bundle is appended to the boot graph by HMR, and a refresh
  makes sure it takes effect.
- **A local directory installs a symlink** (`link:`): after editing, run `node scripts/build-client.mjs` and
  refresh — no reinstall needed.
- **Version coupling**: the styles use only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, the slot is
  `sidebar.footer.action`, and `dsh.client.inject` depends on the sidebar and locale client packages shipped
  with DSH; the balance is read through the **optional** `remote.account` namespace (profiles without an
  account controller hide that section automatically). If DSH renames the slot, the locale API or the account
  Remote, this plugin has to follow.
